title: Project Kaywat
description: This is my optimization modpack for Minecraft. It features many FPS boosting mods, quality of life improvements, and creative mode tools.
body:
# Project Kaywat

This is my main modpack for Minecraft. I tried to use other modpacks for optimization, but they did not have the mods that I needed, so I decided to make my own. This pack includes many mods that I use often but are missing from most other packs, such as Axiom, Carpet with the TIS addition, ViaFabricPlus, and Gamma Utils. Use this modpack if you want a few more mods than other optimization modpacks.


If you have any issues or suggestions, message Kaywat.55 on Discord: discord.com/users/1310701176437739552
